newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume dives as prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume dives as prices fall.

text.p: Istanbul gold volume shrank to 535 kilos on Tuesday, from Monday's 909 kilos as prices fell and traders were sidelined, expecting further price drops, dealers said.
Gold slipped to $348.55 an ounce and 1,407,600 lira per gram on Tuesday, against $352.30 and 1,421,500 lira on Monday following lower levels on European markets.
"There was an expectation on the market that gold would further fall to at least $345.00, so there wasn't much interest at today's levels," one dealer said.
Dealers said 480 kilos of the day's total trade was made in lira terms because of the wide price margin provided by the lira's fluctuations against the dollar during the day.
Gold prices in lira moved between 1,405,500 and 1,418,500 per gram.
Of the day's trade, 280 kilos was registered in the morning session, and 255 kilos in the afternoon with 89.7 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
